evidence: Dropdown menus cannot be opened using the Enter or Space keys.
recommended_fix: Implement keyboard event listeners for dropdowns and ensure semantic button usage.

evidence: The 'Phone Number' input field lacks a connected <label> tag.
user_impact: Screen reader users do not hear what the input is for.
recommended_fix: Add a <label> with a 'for' attribute matching the input 'id'.

evidence: The white text on light blue background has a contrast ratio of 2.1:1.
user_impact: Users with low vision cannot read the banner text.
recommended_fix: Change the background color to a darker shade to meet the 4.5:1 ratio.

evidence: The social media icons do not have alt text or aria-labels.
user_impact: Screen reader users hear generic 'image' or file names.
recommended_fix: Add 'aria-label' or visually hidden text to the icon links.

evidence: Inline links do not have a visible focus outline when tabbed into.
user_impact: Keyboard users cannot see which element currently has focus.
recommended_fix: Add a CSS ':focus-visible' state with a clear outline.
